item.title: Climate incentive programs have an infrastructure problem. — One Billion Machines
item.description: The IRA is our golden opportunity to meet the challenge of the climate crisis - but success will require a rapid, coordinated effort to build new digital and human infrastructure. The Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) is a huge victory for the climate movement, for U.S. households, and for humanity.

item.title: We need to do 10x more in 2025 — One Billion Machines
item.description: Capacity-building for the post-IRA electrification push. Fifteen years ago I first joined the Obama campaign as a volunteer, but within a few days I was ready to quit my comfy job and move across the country to join as a full-time staffer.
